title: The Walking and Cycling Index Residents' Survey 2027
description: Walk Wheel Cycle Trust wishes to commission an area-wide residents' travel behaviour and attitude "push-to-online" survey in up to 16 areas across the UK. The survey will gather data related to travel behaviour, satisfaction and attitudes about a range of issues related to walking, wheeling, cycling and public transport in their area among a representative sample of residents. The successful contractor will design a research methodology and questionnaire tools compatible with the previous methodology and questionnaire, conduct the survey fieldwork, clean and analyse the data and return specified outputs to Walk Wheel Cycle Trust for further analysis and modelling. Walk Wheel Cycle Trust intends to commission for one iteration of fieldwork in 2027. Surveys to take place in 16 areas across the UK. Each survey to secure at least 1,100 respondents. Please see Invitation to Tender for further details. Note that we are procuring for a single supplier framework, and there may be variations in the number of areas. Total value maximum of £675,000 for the core costs of the contract, based on the number of areas above. Note that the same opportunity will be published on Public Contracts Scotland, Sell2Wales and Find a Tender. Full instructions on how the bids can be submitted can be seen in the Invitation to Tender document.

buyer: North York Moors National Park Authority
title: Biodiversity Net Gain and Nutrient Neutrality: Assessment of Opportunity and Delivery Roles for Nort
description: North York Moors and New Forest National Park Authorities (NYMNPA and NFNPA respectively) are responsible for conserving and enhancing two of England's most distinctive protected landscapes. Through their statutory roles, management plans and trusted local relationships, the Authorities support nature recovery, resilient landscapes and the long-term stewardship of the National Parks. Statutory markets for Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) and Nutrient Neutrality (NN) are creating new opportunities to secure long-term investment in nature recovery across England. Since February 2024, BNG has been mandatory for most developments. Similarly, NN is mandatory for housing developments occurring in 27 catchments across England. As Local Planning Authorities, the NPAs already have a regulatory role in relation to these markets. They now wish to understand the opportunities for taking on wider roles, such as supporting off-site habitat and credit delivery with advice and ecology services, convening partners, brokering opportunities for landowners, or developing a habitat bank or similar service. Local planning authorities are also covered by the 'Biodiversity Duty' set out in the Environment Act 2021, requiring them to conserve and enhance biodiversity through proactive measure. National Park Authorities have an important role to play in the delivery of this duty, given the first statutory Park purpose to conserve and enhance the wildlife of National Parks. This commission wil... 2. Options appraisal for roles and services Undertake an options appraisal to assess potential roles or service provisions which could be undertaken by the NPAs, with particular reference to NPA governance, resourcing and local context. Review roles and services in light of opportunities, resource implications, potential risks and any conflicts of interest. Consideration should also be given to how each role might impact the quality of environmental outcomes and/or the ability to secure social and health co-benefits (e.g. public access to green space) from BNG/NN sites. Roles and services considered could include: - Regulator (current position as planning authority) - Responsible body (with respect to conservation covenants which can be used for both BNG and NN schemes) - Advisor - Broker - Provision of ecology services, including monitoring - Habitat Bank operator/supplier - Convenor / facilitator 3. Outline business case For the most favourable option or options, outline a business case including commercial viability, potential to generate a profit or unrestricted funds for NPAs, operational effort, timelines and key dependencies. Include recommended governance and delivery models and any safeguards needed to manage regulatory, legal, financial and reputational risks. 4. Recommendations Provide a series of recommendations and outline an implementation roadmap based on the above assessments, including sequencing, dependencies and key decision points.

title: H&C1025 Sexual Health Services
description: Sexual health needs in the East Riding are shaped by a combination of demographic, geographic, and health inequality factors. Sexual ill health is closely linked with deprivation, rurality, and limited access to services, contributing to avoidable harm and poorer outcomes for specific population groups. In the East Riding sexually transmitted infections, unplanned pregnancies, and associated complications continue to present a significant impact on individuals and the wider health systemThe Service will support delivery against the three nationally mandated Public Health Outcomes Framework (PHOF) indicators relevant to sexual health: · Under 18 conceptions (PHOF 2.04) · Chlamydia detection among 15–24 year olds (PHOF 3.02) · People presenting with HIV at a late stage of infection (PHOF 3.04)

title: Battery-powered Temporary Power Solutions
description: Scottish Water is currently developing its future approach to temporary power solutions. As part of this work, we are seeking to better understand the market for battery-powered temporary power solutions, including supplier capabilities and the availability of both hire and purchase models. Previous market engagement has already established that a range of battery, hybrid and solar-assisted technologies exist within the market. Scottish Water is now seeking practical insight from suppliers with experience deploying battery-powered, hybrid and solar-assisted temporary power solutions across construction, utilities, and infrastructure projects. This work supports Scottish Water's ambitions around Beyond Net Zero, Service Excellence and Great Value & Financial Sustainability, and looks to better understand the role battery-powered temporary power solutions may play in supporting these ambitions. This engagement is intended to inform Scottish Water's understanding of the market and any future approach to temporary power solutions.

title: Lift and Plant Inspection
description: The Scottish Courts and Tribunals Service (SCTS) is seeking to procure a contractor to carry out statutory inspections, testing and certification of all plant and lift equipment in accordance with Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (LOLER), The Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998 (PUWER), The Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and relevant British Standards. Services must include thorough examinations, identification of defects, prioritised recommendations and timely provision of all compliance documentation. All work must be completed by a competent, qualified person and conducted safely with minimal disruption to operations throughout the SCTS estate.

description: Small Business Sources Sought Notice NCI 2026 Cervical Cancer Screening Follow-Up NCI-SBSS-DCEG-TDRP-0001 This is a Small Business Sources Sought notice. This is NOT a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding: (1) the availability and capability of qualified small business sources; (2) whether there are small businesses; HUBZone small businesses; veteran owned small businesses; service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses; 8(a) small businesses; woman-owned small businesses; or small disadvantaged business; and (3) their size classification relative to North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for the proposed acquisition. Your responses to the information requested will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. NAICS Code and Size Standard: The primary NAICS code for this acquisition is 622110- General Medical and Surgical Hospitals, which has a size standard of $47million. All businesses may submit a capability statement; however, a statement should be included indicating whether the company is considered a small business under the above NAICS code. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement as a set-aside based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Interested parties are expected to review this notice and the draft Statement of Work (SOW) to familiarize themselves with the requirements of this project; failure to do so will be at your firm�s own risk. Background: Despite Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines, screening will remain central for decades to control cervical cancer. Recently, HPV testing alone or with cytology was introduced in the US as an alternative to cytology screening. However, most HPV infections are harmless, and additional tests are required to identify women at highest cancer risk. The National Cancer Institute (NCI) has analyzed data for over 1.5 million women screened for cervical cancer at Kaiser Permanente Northern California (KPNC) clinics. In addition, National Cancer Institute (NCI) has funded previous studies conducted at Kaiser Permanente Northern California to collect biospecimens for biomarker testing and to study risk estimates for cervical cancer screening. To continue these efforts and generate long-term risk estimates, follow-up, de-identified clinical data from participants in these studies is required. Purpose and objectives: The NCI will follow the status of women undergoing cervical cancer screening at KPNC. This follow-up requires the Contractor to provide detailed clinical and risk factor history and follow-up data for women enrolled in previous studies, including de-identified data on the status of women undergoing cervical cancer screening at KPNC. This acquisition will collect the results of all Human Papillomavirus (HPV) and cytology-based testing as well as all colposcopy, biopsy and treatment procedures, as well as relevant co-factor data, within their screening program. The purpose of this Small Business Sources Sought Notice is to identify qualified small business concerns including HUBZone small businesses; veteran-owned small business, service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses; 8(a) small businesses; women-owned small businesses; or small disadvantaged businesses that are interested in and capable of performing the work described herein. title: Motorcoach Transportation for USCGA Corps of Cadets
description: The U.S. Coast Guard Academy requires contractor-provided charter motorcoach transportation services for Corps of Cadets and other Government-authorized personnel from November 13 through November 15, 2026, between the U.S. Coast Guard Academy in New London, Connecticut; the U.S. Naval Academy in Annapolis, Maryland; and Audi Field in Washington, D.C. The contractor shall furnish safe, reliable, interstate-compliant motor coaches, qualified and properly licensed drivers and relief drivers, dispatch and contingency support, fuel, tolls, parking, permits, insurance, maintenance, driver lodging and meals, and all other resources needed to perform scheduled passenger movements. Services include transportation for up to 14 motor coaches and 687 cadets for the Saturday morning movement to Audi Field, as well as additional movements between the Academy, USNA, and Audi Field, with sufficient legal seating and baggage capacity for authorized passengers and musical instruments. The contractor shall comply with all applicable safety, vehicle, driver qualification, and hours-of-service requirements; coordinate staging and boarding with Government representatives; promptly report incidents or delays; and provide replacement vehicles and drivers when necessary.

title: Kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja huoltopalvelut ÖVPH Pohjoinen alue
description: Kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja huoltopalvelut ÖVPH Pohjoinen alue Hankinnan kohteena on kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja ylläpitopalvelu Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueen pohjoisella osa-alueella. Palveluun sisältyy lääkinnällisenä kuntoutuksena myönnettyjen kuulokojeiden sovitus ja ylläpitopalvelu sekä muiden yksittäisten korvakappaleisiin ja kuulokojeisiin liittyvien huoltotoimenpiteiden hankinta kaudelle 1.1.2027 - 31.12.2028. Hankintaan sisältyy kaksi kertaa yhden (1 + 1) vuoden optiomahdollisuus (1.1.2029-31.12.2029 ja 1.1.2030-31.12.2030). Option käyttämisestä tehdään erikseen päätös noin kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen sopimuskauden päättymistä. Toiminta-alue on Pohjoinen alue, johon kuuluu Pietarsaari, Kruunupyy, Luoto, Pedersöre ja Uusikaarlepyy. Pietarsaaren alueella on noin 250 kuulonhuoltoasiakasta per vuosi. Asiakasmäärä on arvio eikä tilaaja sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin. Palvelun asiakkaalla on oltava palvelua varten korva-, nenä- ja kurkkutautien toimintayksikön toimintaperiaatteiden mukaisesti hyväksytty lähete tai apuvälinepäätös, jonka määräysten mukaan kuulokojepalvelu toteutetaan. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden tarkastella palvelun järjestämistapaa sopimuskauden aikana. Tarkastelun seurauksena palvelun laajuus voi muuttua tai palvelu voidaan osittain tai kokonaan siirtää tilaajan omaksi toiminnaksi hankintasopimuksen ehtojen mukaisesti.,

title: Kohti työtä ja ammattia -kotoutumiskoulutus
description: Kohti työtä ja ammattia -kotoutumiskoulutus Tampereen kaupunki pyytää tarjouksia tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Kilpailutuksella hankitaan työvoimapalveluiden järjestämisestä annetun lain (380/2023) ja kotoutumisen edistämisestä annetun lain (681/2023) mukaista kotoutumiskoulutusta. Avoimella menettelyllä valitaan yksi palveluntuottaja, jonka kanssa tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa oleva hankintasopimus. Hankittavan palvelun sisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa. Tarjouspyynnön liitteet löytyvät kohdasta Tarjouspyynnön liitteet. Hankittavan palvelun ennakoitu arvo ylittää julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (hankintalaki 1397/2016) 25 §:n mukaisen kynnysarvon liitteen E hankinnoille, joten kilpailutuksessa sovelletaan hankintalakia. Hankintayksikkö valitsee tarjouksista kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimman. Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteet (arviointikriteerit) on esitetty tässä tarjouspyynnössä.,

title: Kansallismuseon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat
description: Kansallismuseon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat Hankinnan kohteena on Museoviraston / Kansallismuseon ("Hankintayksikkö") museon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat ja muut tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt lisävarusteet ("Tavara"). Hankittavien tuotteiden määrät ja tekniset vähimmäisvaatimukset on esitetty liitteenä olevassa valaisinluettelossa. Valaisimien tulee olla suoraan mekaanisesti ja sähköisesti yhteensopivia Kansallismuseon olemassa olevien ERCO 3-vaihevalokiskojen kanssa. Valaisimien runkomateriaalin tulee olla alumiinia. Valaisimiin tulee olla saatavana tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt vaihdettavat optiikat sekä värilämpötilaa lämpimämpään ja kylmempään suuntaan muuttavat suodattimet (Cold, Cold Plus, Warm ja Warm Plus tai vastaavat). Tavaralla tulee olla vähintään viiden (5) vuoden tuotetakuu. Takuu- ja huoltopalvelujen tulee olla saatavilla suomen kielellä. Tavara tulee toimittaa 29.1.2027 mennessä. Valituksi tulevan toimittajan tulee pyrkiä toimittamaan Tavara mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen tekemisen jälkeen ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan ennen määräaikaa. Tarkempi aikataulu sovitaan valitun toimittajan kanssa. Aikataulussa on huomioitava, että Tavaran toimitus tapahtuu museon avaamisprojektin aikana. Edellä mainitusta syystä Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden tarjouspyynnössä esitettyjen ajankohtien aikataulumuutoksiin.,

title: Vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluiden hankinta

Hankittavat palvelut jakaantuvat Vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluiden osalta hallinto- ja tukipalveluihin, raportointiin, hälytyskeskuspalveluihin, vartiointiin ja järjestyksenvalvontaan, etävalvontapalveluihin, turvatarkastukseen sekä muihin tarvittaviin turvallisuuspalveluihin. Salassapitositoumus on tarjouspyynnön liitteenä 1.6. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 2. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus".,

Tarjouspyyntö sisältää seuraavat kaiteet ja käsijohteet: - Porrashuoneen 102 / 201 kaiteet ja käsijohteet o Suunnitelman ARK 32 Sisäporraspiirustus mukaisesti - Ulkotaso A (pääsisäänkäynti) käsijohteet o Suunnitelman ARK 35 Ulkotasot ja luiskat mukaisesti - Ulkotaso B (valmistuskeittiö) käsijohteet o Suunnitelman ARK 35 Ulkotasot ja luiskat mukaisesti Kaiteiden ja käsijohteiden ominaisuudet ja vaatimukset ovat liitetiedostojen ”ARK 32 Sisäporraspiirustus” ja ”ARK 35 Ulkotasot ja luiskat” mukaiset. Toteutusaikataulu: Alustava kaiteiden ja käsijohteiden asennusajankohta on viikko 50/2026. Tarkempi ajankohta sovitaan toimittajan ja tilaajan kesken. Palkkiomuoto ja kulukorvaukset: Tarjous on jätettävä verottomana kokonaishintana (alv 0 %). Hinnan tulee sisältää kaikki työ ja materiaali kustannukset. Maksupostit sovitaan tilauksen yhteydessä. Toimitusosoite on Opintie 2, 85100 Kalajoki. Tarjous tulee jättää kokonaishintana alv 0%. Valintaperusteena kokonaishinnaltaan edullisin tarjous. Laskutuksessa käytetään käännettyä arvonlisäverotusta. Tarjoajan tulee täyttää Tilaajavastuun mukaiset velvoitteet. Hankinnassa sovelletaan YSE1998 sopimusehtoja. description: Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės želdynų ir želdinių inventorizavimo paslaugos. Tiekėjo pasiūlymo kaina negali viršyti 60 000,00 Eur su PVM (arba 49 586,78 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar paslaugos neapmokestinamos PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių, dėl kurių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM), šią sumą viršijantys pasiūlymai bus laikomi nepriimtinais ir bus atmetami. Preliminarūs perkamų paslaugų kiekiai nurodyti konkurso sąlygų aprašo 1 priede, jie Sutarties vykdymo metu pagal Perkančiosios organizacijos poreikį gali būti mažinami arba gali būti didinami. Maksimaliai paslaugų gali būti užsakoma už ne daugiau kaip 60 000,00 Eur su PVM (arba 49 586,78 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar paslaugos neapmokestinamos PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių, dėl kurių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM). Išsamesnė perkamų paslaugų informacija ir reikalavimai pateikiami techninėje specifikacijoje ir jos priede (konkurso sąlygų aprašo 3 priedas). Šis pirkimas į dalis neskaidomas, todėl tiekėjas turi pateikti pasiūlymą visai pirkimo apimčiai bendrai.

title: CPO endoskopinė sistema laparoskopijai su laparoskopinių įrankių rinkiniais, elektrochirurginiu generatoriumi (Tarptautinis pirkimas)
description: Endoskopinė sistema laparoskopijai su laparoskopinių įrankių rinkiniais, elektrochirurginiu generatoriumi. ). Pirkimo objektas skaidomas į 4 atskiras dalis: I pirkimo dalis – endoskopinė sistema laparoskopijai su elektrochirurginiu generatoriumi (2 kompl.). Išsamesnė informacija ir reikalavimai pateikiami techninėje specifikacijoje (konkurso sąlygų aprašo 2 priedas); II pirkimo dalis – instrumentų rinkinys endoskopinei pilvo chirurgijai. Išsamesnė informacija ir reikalavimai pateikiami techninėje specifikacijoje (konkurso sąlygų aprašo 3 priedas); III pirkimo dalis – instrumentų rinkinys endoskopinei ginekologinei chirurgijai. Išsamesnė informacija ir reikalavimai pateikiami techninėje specifikacijoje (konkurso sąlygų aprašo 4 priedas); IV pirkimo dalis – artroskopinių instrumentų rinkinys endoskopinei chirurgijai. Išsamesnė informacija ir reikalavimai pateikiami techninėje specifikacijoje (konkurso sąlygų aprašo 5 priedas); Tiekėjas kartu su pasiūlymu I-IV pirkimo dalims turi pateikti pirkimo sąlygų aprašo 38 p. nurodytus dokumentus. Šis pirkimas skaidomas į dalis, todėl tiekėjas gali pateikti pasiūlymą vienai, kelioms ar visoms pirkimo dalims. Kiekvienai pirkimo daliai bus sudaroma atskira pirkimo sutartis, išskyrus atvejį, kai dėl kelių ar visų pirkimo dalių konkurso laimėtoju bus pripažintas tas pats tiekėjas – tokiu atveju gali būti sudaryta viena pirkimo sutartis.

title: Family Support Services (Inverclyde)
description: Inverclyde Health and Social Care Partnership (HSCP) and the Inverclyde Alcohol and Drug Partnership (ADP) require the delivery of a Family Support Service (FSS) for adults and young people aged 16 years and over, who reside in Inverclyde and are affected by the alcohol and/or drug use of a family member, partner, friend or loved one. The Family Support service will recognise that substance use can have a significant and lasting impact on family members in their own right and that families require support regardless of whether their loved one is currently engaged in treatment, recovery or active substance use. The Family Support service will place families at the centre of all activity and will operate within a framework of: Trauma-Informed Practice Family Inclusive Practice Whole Family Approaches Human Rights Based Practice Recovery-Oriented Systems of Care The Family Support service will provide; early intervention, prevention, emotional support, education, advocacy, peer support, bereavement support, pathways for moving on to other community-based supports when appropriate, and family recovery interventions to improve outcomes for individuals, families and communities across Inverclyde.

description: THIS IS A Sources Sought Notice ONLY. The U.S. Government desires to procure a non-personnel services contract to provide Rental and Service of Portable Chemical Latrines (PCL) and Portable Hand-Washing Station to the U.S. Army Cyber Center of Excellence (CCOE) and Fort Gordon, Georgia, on a small business set-aside basis, provided 2 or more qualified small businesses respond to this source sought synopsis with information sufficient to support a set-aside. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this source sought notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. This is for the procurement of Special Ammunition and Weapon Systems (SAWS) and non-North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) standard ammunition. This is in support of the Department of War (DoW), other U.S. Government (USG) Agencies, foreign governments, and international organizations. This requirement requires highly capable Prime Contractors to procure and deliver a diverse portfolio of Non-Standard Ammunition (NSA) and select Non-Standard Weapon Systems (NSWS). The primary objective of this program is to establish reliable, agile, and responsive supply chains capable of sourcing specialized, foreign produced munitions and weapons systems. These materiel requirements support the National Security Strategy and enable the National Military Strategy for joint warfighters, USG agencies, and international allies or coalition partners. The USG is seeking partners who can guarantee quality and safety despite the "non-standard" nature of these weapons. While these items are not type-classified for U.S. troop use, the Contractor will be strictly evaluated on its ability to provide experience of implementing rigorous quality control, visual and physical inspections, and ballistic testing to deliver safe, reliable, and effective SAWS. The applicable North Atlantic Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 332993 - Ammunition (except Small Arms) Manufacturing Procurement Categories The ammunition and weapon systems to be procured fall within the following Federal Supply Groups (FSGs) provided in the SAWS Tailored Federal Supply Classification (FSC) Item List (Attachment 0001). With limited exceptions, all items must be compatible with the applicable weapons within their associated General Specification(s) for PdL SAWS (Attachments 0003 - 0007). FSGs and subordinate FSC codes used as a basis for categories (Attachment 0001). Contract and Award Details Source Selection A Highest Technically Rated Offeror (HTRO) source selection approach will be utilized. This is referenced in the DoD Source Selection Procedures (para 1.3.1.5) and will be conducted in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 15.103-3 and the DoD Source Selection Procedures. Technical Experience Evaluation Offerors are required to use the HTRO Self-Score Matrix (Attachment 0008) to self-score their past technical experience. To substantiate their self-scores, Offerors must submit work samples documenting relevant past technical experience as either a Prime Contractor or a Subcontractor. It is the USG's expressed authority to reject or accept any additional terms and conditions proposed by an Offeror. 26-58124 Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS)-Deployable Integrated Topographic and Bathymetric (Topo-Bathymetric) LiDAR System
description: 26-58124 Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS)-Deployable Integrated Topographic and Bathymetric (Topo-Bathymetric) LiDAR System Solicitation Closes at 02 :00 PM on 26 October 2026 Time Zone EDT RETURN BIDS TO: NRC.BidReceiving-ReceptiondesSoumissions.CNRC@nrc-cnrc.gc.ca Statement of Requirement Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS)-Deployable Integrated Topographic and Bathymetric (Topo-Bathymetric) LiDAR System. The National Research Council of Canada’s (NRC) Centre for Drone Innovation (CDI), part of the Drone and Flight Autonomy Laboratory (DFAL), requires one (1) integrated topo bathymetric LiDAR system deployable from NRC’s medium class Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) to support research, development, testing, method validation, and operational deployments. The system must capture above water topography and shallow water bathymetry within a single factory integrated payload and deliver survey grade outputs through a manufacturer supported hydrographic processing workflow. BACKGROUND: LiDAR is used to generate high accuracy topographic data and digital elevation models by measuring precise distances between a sensor and target surfaces. Conventional topographic LiDAR typically operates at near infrared wavelengths that do not penetrate water, so surveys end at the water surface. To characterize shorelines and other shallow water features within a single survey, a topo bathymetric capability is required to detect both the water surface and submerged bottom under suitable conditions. To support dual use applications such as shoreline mapping, shallow water target detection, wildfire resource assessment, infrastructure inspection, emergency response, and evaluation of potential autonomous landing sites, the Remote Sensing Imaging Group (RSIG) within the Drone and Flight Autonomy Laboratory (DFAL) requires an integrated topo bathymetric LiDAR system deployable from NRC’s medium class RPAS. RSIG, with support from NRC’s Design and Fabrication Department and the Flight Research Laboratory Instrumentation Group, will integrate the system on NRC platforms. Given the field based, survey grade nature of the work, dependable vendor support, training, and documentation are required to maintain operational readiness and minimize downtime, reduce technical risk, and maintain continuity of operations. 1.0 Requirement: Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS)-deployable integrated topographic and bathymetric (topo-bathymetric) LiDAR system (the system), quantity one (1) Specifications: The system must: 1.1 Integrated topo-bathymetric capability -collect both topographic and bathymetric LiDAR data using a single integrated payload 1.2 Bathymetric green laser -use a green laser wavelength (532 nm) providing both terrestrial measurements and water-surface and sub-aqueous bottom returns. 1.3 Unconditional full-waveform recording -record the full return waveform unconditionally for every emitted laser pulse, so that weak submerged-bottom echoes can be recovered, averaged, and reprocessed rather than being permanently lost when they fall below a real-time detection threshold 1.4 Measurement rate and multi-target capability -provide user-selectable measurement rates of up to at least 200 kHz, record at least 15 target returns per emitted pulse, and provide 16-bit intensity information. 1.5 Selectable beam divergence -provide user-selectable laser-beam divergence, adjustable over a range of at least 1 mrad to 6 mrad, so that acquisition can be optimized for different flight altitudes, water clarity, and turbidity conditions. 1.6 Water penetration -be capable of penetrating a minimum of 2 m of clear water under zero-turbidity conditions. 1.7 Scanning field of view - provide an effective scanning field of view of at least 40 degrees perpendicular to the flight direction, equivalent to an off-nadir scan angle of at least 20 degrees, suitable for RPAS topo-bathymetric mapping. 1.8 Integrated survey-grade GNSS/INS - include a fully integrated Global Navigation Satellite System / Inertial Navigation System (GNSS/INS) providing, after post-processing, horizontal position accuracy of 5 cm or better, vertical position accuracy of 10 cm or better, roll and pitch accuracy of 0.02 degrees or better, and heading accuracy of 0.05 degrees or better. The GNSS/INS must be compatible with NRC’s existing Applanix POSPac trajectory post-processing workflow and must be supplied with the required post-processing software licence. 1.9 Integrated RGB camera - include an integrated, co-aligned RGB camera with a minimum resolution of 20 megapixels, supporting co-registration of the LiDAR data with true-colour imagery for draped surface products, structure-from-motion applications, and three-dimensional surface visualization 1.10 Onboard data storage - include internal solid-state data storage and support removable storage media. 1.11 Environmental protection - be suitable for outdoor field operations and provide protection against dust and environmental moisture appropriate for RPAS-based operations, with an ingress protection rating of at least IP64. 1.12 Operating environment - be suitable for operation in Canadian outdoor field conditions, including ambient temperatures below freezing down to -10 °C, and withstand storage and transportation at temperatures down to -20 °C. 1.13 Hydrographic processing software - include manufacturer-supported software covering the complete RPAS-based topo-bathymetric workflow, including: mission planning; system operation and data acquisition; data download and management; inertial data processing; kinematic LiDAR data processing; system calibration; water-surface modelling; correction of underwater measurements for refraction and light-travel time; full-waveform bathymetric analysis; RGB image processing; rigorous data adjustment; quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC); and export of processed data products to commonly used formats, including LAS. 1.14 Calibration - be delivered with system boresight calibration and digital camera calibration completed, together with the applicable calibration documentation for the integrated sensing components. 1.15 Technical Documentation - provide a comprehensive technical manual, including diagrams and/or procedures for troubleshooting and performing basic maintenance tasks. 1.16 RPAS compatibility The complete sensor payload must be suitable for deployment on medium-class RPAS, must have a total payload weight not exceeding 12 kg, and must be capable of integration on NRC’s medium-class RPAS through appropriate mechanical, electrical, and communications interfaces, and must operate from a DC power supply of 18–34 VDC. 1.17 Manufacturer repairs All repairs and recalibration must be performed at the manufacturer’s facility or by a manufacturer-authorized service provider, with documentation provided following each repair or recalibration. 2.0 Training: The Contractor must provide comprehensive RPAS-based topo-bathymetric operations and workflow training for up to four (4) NRC personnel covering, at minimum: • mission planning; • system operation and data acquisition; • operational best practices; • data download; • inertial data processing; • refraction correction; • LiDAR and image data processing; • full-waveform bathymetric analysis; • data quality assurance and • quality control (QA/QC); and export of processed data products. The location of the training to be determined following integration of the system on an NRC RPAS. 3.0 Warranty and Support: 3.1 Warranty The system and all supplied hardware must include a minimum twelve (12) month manufacturer’s warranty covering material and manufacturing defects and operation within the manufacturer’s specifications, commencing upon acceptance of the goods. The warranty must include access to interim software releases and version updates issued during the warranty period. description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT (NPP) Solicitation #: 30008200 This requirement is for Fisheries and Oceans Canada Title: Stream to Sea Program Delivery and Coordination Services: South Coast – Parksville, Qualicum, Comox Valley Objective: Fisheries and Oceans Canada, requires Contractors to provide delivery and coordination services for the Stream to Sea Program, as defined by the Project Authority, for schools within School Districts listed below, as well as Independent Schools, other Learning Centres, and community partners in the same geographic area: Parksville, Qualicum, Comox Valley (including School Districts (SD) 69 and 71) Stream to Sea Program delivery and coordination services are required over the entire duration of this Contract with some times requiring more commitment than others. Delivery and coordination services will be defined on a geographic specific basis through the development of work plan details using the information provided in Appendix 1 (Statement of Work). The Contractor will work with the Project Authority, to coordinate and deliver the Stream to Sea Program in schools and with local community groups. The work will consist of training educators, coordinating and assisting with set up of classroom incubators (aquaria), delivering salmon eggs to schools, providing classroom (indoor and outdoor) sessions which may include the salmon life cycle, fish dissections, aquatic ecosystems and habitat requirements for salmon, environmental sustainability as it relates to salmon, stream to sea migration and other salmon focused education pertinent to the area. The Contractor will provide trouble shooting and maintenance support for aquaria in schools and develop or assist with the development and delivery of a spring fry release program for participating schools. In some instances, the Contractor may participate in the live transport of adult and juvenile salmon and may participate in the spawning of broodstock. Contractor will also support Pacific Region tracking and reporting (i.e. brood stock summary and year end stream to sea data collection/reporting). The Stream to Sea Program aims to develop opportunities for external parties to be involved. Contractors may be required to facilitate and develop opportunities with local communities, First Nations, and community groups. title: Design, Installation, Maintenance and Support of Electronic Security Systems
description: Given the evolving threat environment both in Canada and internationally, NRCan is focused on strengthening the physical security posture of its facilities. This includes improving access control, surveillance, and intrusion detection capabilities to ensure personnel safety and operational continuity. NRCan operates an electronic security and surveillance system consisting of access control, video management, and intrusion detection systems deployed across multiple locations nationwide. The system is maintained through a combination of in-house IT and security resources, as well as contracted security system support and integration services. The system transitioned from legacy analog infrastructure to an IP-based architecture between 2016 and 2020, with ongoing enhancements through 2023. The current security system is built on a hybrid cloud and on-premises architecture, designed to balance cost and performance with confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements. The system includes approximately 500 card readers and 500 cameras across more than 25 sites and is monitored through the NRCan Security Operations Control Centre (SOCC) located at 580 Booth Street in Ottawa, Ontario.

title: Oulun Tilapalvelut - Hissien huolto- ja korjauspalvelut
description: Oulun Tilapalvelut - Hissien huolto- ja korjauspalvelut HANKINNAN KOHDE Oulun Tilapalvelut -liikelaitos pyytää tarjoustanne hallinnoimiensa kiinteistöjen hissien huolto- ja korjauspalveluista sekä hälytyskeskuspalveluista. Hankinnan kohteena ovat hissien kokonaisvaltainen huolto-, kunnossapito-, korjaus- ja päivystyspalvelu. Palveluun sisältyvät lisäksi hissien toiminnan ylläpitämiseksi tarvittavat muut huolto- ja korjaustoimenpiteet. Palvelun tavoitteena on varmistaa hissien turvallinen, luotettava ja keskeytyksetön toiminta sekä ylläpitää laitteiden tekninen kunto valmistajien ohjeiden, viranomaismääräysten ja hyvän kunnossapitotavan mukaisesti. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö on kuvattu tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 1 (Palvelunkuvaus). Lisäksi liitteessä 2, (Laiteluettelo / Tarjousliite) on kerrottu jokaisen hissin vaadittu huoltomäärä vuodessa. SOPIMUSJÄRJESTELY Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely yhden (1) palveluntuottajan kanssa. TOIMEKSIANTOJEN TOTEUTUS Perushuollot toteutetaan sovitun huolto-ohjelman mukaisesti. Kiireettömien töiden tilaukset tehdään P2P-tilausjärjestelmällä, joka toimii samalla tilauksen sopimuksena. Tilauksen yhteydessä sovitaan toimeksiannon sisältö, aikataulu sekä arvioitu työmäärä. Mikäli sovitusta aikataulusta myöhästytään palveluntuottajasta johtuvasta syystä, tilaajalla on oikeus periä sopimusluonnoksen mukaiset sanktiot. HINNOITTELU JA TARJOUKSEN SISÄLTÖ Tarjous tulee laatia tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Tarjouksen tulee kattaa kaikki palvelun toteuttamiseksi tarvittavat työt. Mahdolliset lisätyöt hinnoitellaan tarjouspyynnön mukaisesti. Perushuollot laskutetaan laitekohtaisilla tarjoushinnoilla. Muut huolto- ja korjaustyöt laskutetaan tarjotun tuntihinnan sekä toteutuneen materiaalikulutuksen mukaisesti. SOPIMUSKAUSI Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta. Sopimuskauden tavoiteltu alkamispäivä on 1.12.2026. Mikäli sopimuskauden aloitus viivästyy esimerkiksi muutoksenhaun vuoksi, sopimuskausi alkaa vasta, kun asiaan on saatu lainvoimainen ratkaisu. Määräaikaisen sopimuskauden jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa optioilla: - yksi (1) + yksi (1) vuotta Optiokaudet alkavat tavoitellusti: - 1.11.2028 (1. optiovuosi) - 1.11.2029 (2. optiovuosi) Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä. Sopimus jatkuu optiokausille automaattisesti, ellei tilaaja ilmoita kirjallisesti halustaan olla käyttämättä optiota viimeistään kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen kunkin optiokauden alkamista. HISSIEN LISÄÄMINEN JA POISTAMINEN Sopimuskaudella hankinnan kohteet voivat lisääntyä tai vähentyä ja tilaajalla on oikeus lisätä tai poistaa kohteita sopimuksesta ilman irtisanomisaikaa. Lisättyihin ja poistettuihin kohteisiin sovelletaan tarjouksen mukaisia hintatasoja. TAKUUAIKAISTEN HISSIEN HUOLTOVASTUU Tämä hankinta ei koske takuuaikaisia huolto- ja korjauspalveluja. Takuuaikaiset hissit pysyvät toimituksesta tai hissin korjauksesta vastanneen toimittajan huollossa takuuajan päättymiseen saakka. Takuuajan päätyttyä huolto- ja korjausvastuu siirtyy tämän sopimuksen mukaiselle palveluntuottajalle. Tilaaja ilmoittaa palveluntuottajalle takuuajan päättymisajankohdan. SOPIMUSEHDOT JA HANKINTAPÄÄTÖS Palvelussa noudatetaan JYSE 2025 -ehtoja. Tilaajalla on oikeus hylätä kaikki tarjoukset perustellusta syystä. Tarjoukset eivät saa sisältää tarjoajan omia ehtoja. HANKINNAN KÄYTTÄJÄT Sopimusta voivat käyttää Oulun Tilapalvelut -liikelaitoksen lisäksi myös muut Oulun kaupungin hallintokunnat ja liikelaitokset, joilla on sama Y-tunnus, kuten Oulun Kaupunkiympäristöpalvelut ja Oulun Vesi.,

title: Isännöintipalvelut Vesanto
description: Isännöintipalvelut Vesanto Hankinnan kohteena ovat Vesannon Vuokratalot Oy: tarvitsemat isännöintipalvelut ja niihin liittyvät palvelut seuraavasti: Asumisen rahoitus- ja kehittämiskeskuksen (ARA) julkaiseman vuokratalon isännöintitehtäväluettelon (liite 2) kiinteään palkkioon sisältyvien tehtävien sekä erillispalkkioon oikeuttavien tehtävien hoitaminen. Vuokrakohteet, jotka hankittava palvelu käsittää, käyvät ilmi tarjouspyynnön liitteestä (liite 3 Kohdeluettelo, toimitetaan pyydettäessä). Isännöitäviä kohteita on tällä hetkellä 136 kohdetta. Palveluntuottajan tulee nimetä yrityksestään henkilö hoitamaan yhtiön toimitusjohtajan tehtäviä. Toimitusjohtajan tehtävien hoitamisesta ei suoriteta erillistä korvausta, vaan toimitusjohtajan työtehtävät sisältyvät kiinteään palkkioon. title: Biometric Identity Services
description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This RFI is for planning purposes only and shall not be construed as an obligation on the part of the Government. This is NOT a Request for Quotations or Proposals. No solicitation document exists, and a formal solicitation may or may not be issued by the Government as a result of the responses received to this RFI. The Government will not pay for any response or demonstration expenses. Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary or competition sensitive information contained in their response. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Those who respond to this RFI should not anticipate feedback concerning their submission. All submissions will become the property of the Government and will not be returned. Responding to the RFI is completely voluntary and will not enhance or adversely affect responses to any resulting solicitation if such solicitation is issued at a later date. There is no competitive advantage gained by any of the respondents to this RFI. DESCRIPTION The Office of Biometric Identity Management (OBIM) is the Congressionally designated lead entity within the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), responsible for biometric identity services. The capability to match, store, share, and analyze biometric identity information includes OBIM�s operation, maintenance, and improvement of the central DHS biometric repository which is currently the Automated Biometric Identification System (IDENT), and in the future the in-development replacement system for IDENT, Homeland Advanced Recognition Technology (HART). OBIM provides DHS and its mission partners with biometric identity services that enable national security and public safety decision making. As one of the world�s largest biometric repositories, OBIM�s biometric system contains the identities of over 300 million individuals. OBIM Identity Operations Division (IOD) is seeking professional services to provide biometric examiners, multimodal biometric examiners and identity services to support OBIM with multimodal biometric accuracy and identity services expertise for the Biometric Accuracy Analysis Team (BAAT) and Biometric Support Center (BSC), to support OBIM�s current and future biometric capabilities. OBIM�s biometric system currently utilizes fingerprints, latent prints, face, and iris to support its biometric mission needs but expects the capabilities to expand to meet stakeholder needs in the future. The contractor shall provide multimodal biometric accuracy and identity services expertise to include: � Biometric examination services � Identity management capabilities and biometric support services � Biometric accuracy and quality analysis � Data analysis Government provided software will be used in support of this work effort. Software used may change during the course of the contract; however, the type of work will remain the same. The contractor shall provide multimodal biometric accuracy and identity services expertise to include: Biometric examination services for all modalities Identity management capabilities and biometric support services Biometric accuracy and quality analysis Data analysis In addition, as part of this effort, the Government expects: Innovative approaches to staffing in order to ensure resources are applied in the most efficient manner Application of industry best practices across all tasks Collaboration across BAAT and BSC teams to ensure mission needs are met and opportunities for efficiency improvements are identified The contractor is responsible for providing oversight of the work performed in accordance with the Project Management Plan and for establishing/maintaining a Quality Assurance program. Biometric Examiner and Identity Management Services Although OBIM�s biometric system is very accurate and executes hundreds of thousands of biometric services each day, BSC biometric examiners and analysts are needed to supplement the automated capabilities of the system, respond to stakeholder requests for biometrics identity services, and to maintain and improve the accuracy of the system through identity management tasks and in support of the BAAT accuracy activities. The contractor shall provide qualified personnel to support the Biometric Support Center (BSC) with the following duties: Analyze and compare biometric images to render identity decisions when the automated matchers are unable Resolve candidate lists generated by the automated system when biometrics are searched Prepare reports as needed to support examiner identity decision conclusions Correct biometric capture issues so that future matching is improved Maintain the identities within IDENT/HART through record reviews and analysis of biometric identity conflicts, errors, etc. Support stakeholder biometric service requests for those stakeholders who are not able to execute these requests through automated capabilities Provide subject matter expertise and technical support in support of BSC operations Note: The BSC is not a forensic laboratory; therefore, the scope of this work does not include the handling/processing of physical evidence. Biometric Accuracy and Data Analysis Additionally, the contractor shall provide data accuracy and quality analysis to manage the accuracy of biometric identity information. The government is expecting support for the Biometric Accuracy Analysis Team (BAAT) which is dedicated to the monitoring, analysis, reporting, and correction of the biometric data within the HART database. The contractor is responsible for providing data integrity analysis, reporting services and related analysis services, as required, for OBIM�s IOD. Support includes technical subject matter expertise, project management services as well as audit recommendations and advice on corrective actions and guidance to the field. The contractor shall also provide statistical analysis of system data to support requirements identification. The contractor shall provide qualified personnel to support the Biometric Accuracy Analysis Team (BAAT) with the following duties: Conducting comprehensive testing of biometric data to assess accuracy and quality of stakeholder biometric data, vendor matchers, presentation attack detection tools, and data quality software Supporting the development, implementation and automation of biometric programs Collaborate within OBIM and with stakeholders to ensure alignment with operational goals and standards to improve biometric match response accuracy Create statistically representative biometric data cohorts as authorized to support mission needs Perform ad hoc root-cause-analysis of biometric based anomalies. Enhance existing processes, infrastructure, and architecture to better support operations Support the maintenance and production of Microsoft Power Platform based applications Ensure adherence to record keeping protocols by leveraging existing methods and applying authorized process improvements methods Publish impactful findings to support best practices throughout OBIM and its stakeholders Attend conferences and meetings related to biometric knowledge sharing to support OBIM Establish metrics to enable a notification-based dashboard to support system monitoring Task Order Management The government expects: The establishment and maintenance of a roadmap that aligns the efforts of the BSC and BAAT with the broader Systems Business Operations Branch. The design, development, and integration of Microsoft Power Platform solutions, existing Excel reports, and the Pyramid Business Intelligence application to seamlessly dashboard key performance metrics. Routine coordination and planning between Key Personnel; Biometric Examiner Lead and Biometric Information Technology/Identification Systems Specialist to establish seamless methods of documenting, tracking, reporting, and supporting contractor activity.
